description: Fetch one published guide, structured as intro + sections, with its canonical URL for citation. Slugs come from search-guides. Pass brief:true on a voice call or when you only need enough to answer one question — the full read is long.

brief.description: Short read: the first few sections, trimmed. Use on voice.

sections.description: How many sections to return (1-12, default 12; 4 when brief)

name: get-guide
